items.title: after 不宜直接当 later 连接后续动作
items.explanation: 表达“后来……”时，after 不能直接替代 later/then/afterward 来承接后续动作；自然说法是 but later settled 或 but then settled。
items.source: They comes from back east first, but after they settle down in yalisang.
items.example: They originally came from back east, but later settled in Arizona.

items.title: 公司总部常用 headquarters
items.explanation: 表达“公司总部”通常用 headquarters，而不是 head；head 更常指人或身体部位。
items.source: The company has several office in the east, but the head is in Chigaco.
items.example: The company has several offices in the East, but its headquarters is in Chicago.

items.title: 过去叙事中的时态不一致
items.explanation: 同一段已发生的连续事件应保持一般过去时；前句使用 read 表示过去时后，后句应使用 turned 和 followed。
items.source: After entering exhibit, they close their phone and follow guide
items.example: After entering the exhibition hall, they turned off their phones and followed the guide.

items.title: back east 前不加 in
items.explanation: back east 本身可作地点副词短语，表示“在/向美国东部那边”，前面通常不再加 in；应说 lived back east，而不是 lived in back east。
items.source: After living in back east for years, I moved eastward to visit my sister.
items.example: After living back east for years, I moved west to start a new job.
